newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Russia UN mission hits out at U.S. Iraq action.
newsitem.headline: Russia UN mission hits out at U.S. Iraq action.

text.p: The Government of the Russian Federation, in a statement issued on Tuesday through its permanent mission to the United Nations, hit out at the United States' military action against Baghdad.
In response to the U.S. missile attack against Baghdad for Iraq's attacks on internationally protected Kurdish zones in the north of Iraq, the Russian government issued the following statement:

"The government of the Russian Federation holds the U.S. military operation as a disproportionate and unacceptable response to the developments of the last few days in northern Iraq where the situation has long been unstable, with an evident systematic interference by external forces. The more so, as the Iraqi leadership -- thanks to the efforts made, including steps taken by Russia -- has announced the beginning of withdrawal of its troops from Kurdistan to their original forward positions

"In a situation of growing tensions in the region, Russia has repeatedly warned against forceful measures, indicating their possible dangerous regional and international consequences. Unfortunately, Washington has opted for a different modus operandi.

"Russia insists on a cessation of all military action in Iraq, action which threatens the sovereignty and territorial integrety of that country. The strain of the situation must be taken off by political means as soon as possible.

"In broader terms, time has finally come to ponder over the consequences of endless delays in a post-crisis settlement in the Persian Gulf zone. Reliance on force-based methods in regards to Iraq has never stopped producing new crises in the region.
"Iraq should see a true perspective of a way out of international isolation, of course on the basis of a strict compliance with the relevant resolutions of the United Nations Security Council.
